meta.parties: Juan Appu v. Pelo Appu Et Al

rules.statement: In partition actions, costs should be borne by the co-owners pro rata.
rules.supporting_quote: "I feel constrained, although with reluctance, to set aside the order from which this appeal is brought, and to direct that the costs of all the parties, including those of the respondents, on whose behalf a statement of objections was filed, should be borne pro rata."
